artefact_identity.note: Artefact identity is separate from the transport markers on purpose: the known splice attack is a well-formed gzip object, so CRC32/framing/terminal markers pass on it. Identity (hash and decoded size) and the in-window continuity rules are what refuse it.

coverage_certificate.definition: qualified = corrected-universe point-in-time Stock Directory membership; denominator = qualified symbols carrying a valid Closing Cross print; numerator = denominator symbols that also carry both frozen Closing-Cross NOII reads with Closing-Cross NOII cadence inside the signal interval. This is the input-availability coverage the branch's own 0.95 floor and the repo's established coverage machinery measure: the frozen data inputs are present. Imbalance-direction eligibility is NOT part of this numerator: direction N/O/P is a market state (no imbalance), not a hole in the data, and it is reported separately below as the signal scope.

noii_cadence.bound: 15 s (1.5 x the 10 s period this session exhibits) between consecutive Closing-Cross NOII reads inside 15:50:00-15:55:00 ET; one missed dissemination cycle fails
noii_cadence.whole_window_note: Diagnostic only: the whole-window figure includes the feed's own dissemination boundaries, so it is a property of the schedule rather than of this branch's inputs. Observed closing-read dissemination runs from 15:50:00.000298551 to 16:00:00.459966440 (384270 reads inside the signal interval), which is why the cadence bound is stated over the signal interval.

signal_scope.definition: denominator symbols for which the FROZEN sign rule yields a signed imbalance at BOTH reads (direction B or S). The frozen formulation declares direction N/O/P 'missing and ineligible'; measured here, every such read carries ImbalanceShares == 0, and symbols whose two reads are both N have delta_imbalance == 0 and no signal under any reading.

measurement_window_continuity.whole_retained_stream_max_gap_note: Out-of-window separations are large by construction (Stock Directory at 03:0x, closing system events at 16:00/20:00/20:05) and are declared non-material to this branch's inputs. The figure is reported so a hole is never hidden; the bound that certifies the window is the in-window one.

splice_negative_control.verdict_note: The splice keeps 0.92% of the decoded session and still passes every transport marker, which is why transport markers alone are not a completeness contract. The certificate refuses it on three independent grounds: it carries 585996 messages inside 15:49:50-16:00:10 ET where the real session carries at least 1000000; its largest in-window inter-message gap is 609.647 s against a 1 s bound; and its decoded size is not the retained artefact's.

universe_repair.repair_reason: ITCH Appendix E defines Issue Sub-Type C='Common Shares' and Z='Not Applicable', and Nasdaq marks ordinary common stock with Issue Classification=C, Issue Sub-Type=Z; the frozen clause 'Issue Sub-Type=C' was therefore a transcription artefact, not a universe (it admits 31 of 12809 locates). The corrected clause admits Nasdaq-listed common stock (Market Category Q/G/S) and drops the sub-type constraint. Zero-share and zero-price cross prints concentrate in the non-Nasdaq-listed categories, so the correction is also what removes the bulk of the unprintable crosses rather than silently re-scoping around them.

verdict.completeness_statement: The transport markers certify that the retained object is intact and that the feed ended on its End-of-Messages event; they do NOT prove that the original session was captured whole. Only the frozen measurement window 15:49:50-16:00:10 ET is certified, by the in-window continuity rules and the per-symbol NOII cadence; holes outside that window are declared non-material to this branch's inputs, because no frozen signal instant, entry instant or exit print lies outside it and a book reconstructed from the window cannot observe pre-window state in any case.
